title: Ground Crew task (one entry in tasks/tasks.yaml)

id.description: Task id; also the MCP prompt name

description.description: One or two sentences on what the task produces

unit.description: The unit of work one lease covers, e.g. 'one state', 'one claim file'

output.description: Where the results land once merged

schema.description: Path, relative to the crew directory, of the JSON schema every finding for this task must satisfy

skill.description: Path, relative to the crew directory, of the Markdown skill that runs the task

collection.description: The data/ collection approved findings are merged into

scopes.description: Optional closed list of claimable scopes. When absent any non-empty scope string may be claimed.

record_key.description: Top-level fields of a finding's record that together identify the record, e.g. [state, number] for a bill. A new finding replaces a pending one for the same task only when every one of these fields matches, ignoring case, spacing and punctuation. When absent the server uses external_id, nces_id or id, then name within region or state.
